name: Kouda Yuu
source: A 1st year student of the same class as Misaki, to whom she is friends with. She has a furious hatred towards men and will show no mercy to any that approaches Misaki, especially on Haruka who she thinks, is just playing around and doesn't actually want to be friends with her dear Misaki. She is obviously in love with Misaki.
